The cohomological comparison, signed integral period lines, distribution-valued symbols and p-adic interpolation go beyond that anchor; critical-slope theory is imported from PadicFamilies:L3.

MotivesAndAlgebraicCycles.reason: Retain pure Chow and numerical motives, geometric mixed comparisons, Nori motives and periods. Import higher Chow complexes and the effective motivic-homotopy construction; finite correspondences are not Chow correspondences.

ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.1.keeps: Keep compact lattice, rational and discrete-quotient coefficient comparisons; the common module/complex Mittag–Leffler and Milnor lemmas with lim^1 retained; actual cochain/topology comparisons, rationalization and completed-tensor hypotheses. Reuse the pinned continuousCohomology carrier and the anchor's discrete theory.
ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.1.reason: Discrete cohomology and its finite-quotient carrier already belong to the anchor; passing to nondiscrete coefficients is a new comparison, not a definition by fiat.

ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.2.keeps: Keep the full continuous Hochschild–Serre spectral sequence for the stated closed normal subgroup/coefficient classes, convergence, edge-map identifications and arithmetic restriction descent. Import the anchor's finite/discrete change-of-groups and five-term special cases.
ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.2.reason: The anchor's five-term and change-of-groups theory is an input, not the full spectral sequence.

ArithmeticGaloisDuality:D7.keeps: Keep the derived local/global arithmetic duality maps, compact-support and modified real-place complexes, and source-scoped perfectness/amplitude theorems. Import R02.1 limits, R02.2 descent, R02.3 arithmetic finiteness, R02.4 finite/lattice duality and P7 local perfect-complex algebra; prove the application-specific hypotheses.
ArithmeticGaloisDuality:D7.reason: Derived arithmetic duality is distinct from both the underlying limit lemma and abstract perfect-complex algebra.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:P7.keeps: Keep perfect complexes over the specified complete Noetherian local coefficient rings, minimal models, Tor amplitude, derived tensor/Hom, derived completion, Nakayama and coefficient-change spectral sequences. Import the module/complex Milnor and Mittag–Leffler statements from R02.1 and verify their hypotheses for these systems.
DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:P7.reason: Generic lim^1/Mittag–Leffler algebra is owned once by R02.1; its derived local-ring applications are not dropped.

ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.5.keeps: Keep deformation-specific local tangent identifications, changes of deformation conditions and Poitou–Tate dimension calculations. Use the generic Selmer kernel, local-condition and mapping-fibre definitions from L2, with its H0 corrections; prove each deformation condition has the asserted tangent space.
ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.5.reason: A deformation-theoretic Selmer calculation consumes, rather than reconstructs, the general local-condition/complex API.

ArithmeticGaloisDuality:D8.keeps: Keep dimension-general adjoint/dual-adjoint deformation–Selmer comparisons, with trace-zero and determinant conventions valid when p divides the rank, and the arithmetic specialization of derived coefficient change. Import generic Selmer complexes from L2, control maps from L3 and Tor/base-change algebra from P7; do not assume trace-zero adjoints self-dual.
ArithmeticGaloisDuality:D8.reason: Abstract Selmer and Tor constructions have other owners; identifying actual deformation tangent/obstruction data with them remains new mathematics.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L0.reason: The extension belongs to p-adic arithmetic Kummer and its comparison maps, not a second continuous-cohomology carrier.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L1.keeps: Keep annihilator, saturation and local/global pairing comparisons for the stated coefficient modules and supplied local subcomplex maps. Import global finiteness, Poitou–Tate and derived duality, including real-place corrections. Formulate the parametric pairing lemmas before L2 instantiates named conditions; period-defined conditions remain in L4.
SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L1.reason: Arithmetic duality is imported; verifying a particular local condition and its orthogonal is retained. This does not insert an L2-to-L1 cycle.

MotivicEtaleKTheory:M.1.reason: M.1 supplies compatible arithmetic coefficients, not a second cohomology theory or an assumed general regulator.

MotivicEtaleKTheory:M.2.reason: The arithmetic K-theory application must still identify its maps and real-place correction terms; general duality is not re-proved here.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:R03.keeps: Keep the general complete Noetherian local O-algebra and Artin coefficient categories, residue identifications, continuity, small extensions, power-series and completed-tensor interfaces. DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:R03.keeps: Keep the general regular-sequence, depth, Cohen–Macaulay, Auslander–Buchsbaum, complete-intersection, catenary/excellence and support algebra needed for patching. DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:R03.reason: Katz–Mazur regularity of a moduli problem does not supply every local-ring depth theorem.

GlobalGaloisDeformations:R04.1.reason: General coefficient and Schlessinger machinery are shared; the Galois deformation functor is the retained construction.

GlobalGaloisDeformations:R04.2.keeps: Keep arithmetic G_F,S representability, framing, universal representations and determinant variants, proving the required finiteness and endomorphism hypotheses. Import R02.3 finiteness and R03.2 representability algebra; local G_K applications remain R08.1.
GlobalGaloisDeformations:R04.2.reason: Local and global representability are distinct applications of the same general criterion.

GlobalGaloisDeformations:R04.3.keeps: Keep the actual local-to-global completed-tensor presentation, framed constraints and deformation-specific tangent/obstruction formulas, including the stated KW II 4.5/4.7 hypotheses. GlobalGaloisDeformations:R04.3.reason: A presentation of the actual global functor is not supplied by a dimension count alone.

LocalGaloisDeformationRings:R08.1.reason: There is one generic Galois deformation recipe; local arithmetic finiteness and universal-ring applications still need proof.

LocalGaloisDeformationRings:R08.4.keeps: Keep the rank-two Barsotti–Tate ordinary/nonordinary component, connectedness and image-comparison theorems, including the dyadic hypotheses. GlobalGaloisDeformations:G7.keeps: Keep the polarized dimension-n global deformation functor, trace/dual conventions and ACC+ auxiliary-prime presentation. GlobalGaloisDeformations:G8.keeps: Keep the unpolarized, variable-determinant global problem, its local tensor presentation, universal representation and ACC+ 6.2.2 framing counts under its exact hypotheses. GlobalGaloisDeformations:G8.reason: Polarized and variable-determinant functors have distinct deformation data and dimension calculations.
